communicationHint: Choose for each channel whether Zahlmeister sends internally or opens the app on this device.
externalChannelHint: Uses the mail, messages or WhatsApp app on this device. No provider account in Zahlmeister is required.
internalChannelHint: Zahlmeister sends through your own provider account and can record delivery and replies.
externalManualHint: External delivery opens the selected app and must be sent manually.
internalAutomaticHint: Internal delivery can be sent automatically and scheduled.
messageTemplateHint: The same text is used for every communication channel.
sameMessageAllChannels: Email, SMS, WhatsApp and other channels use the same message.
variablesHelp: Tap a variable to insert it at the cursor position.
contactsPermissionDenied: Access to contacts was not granted.
advancedCommunicationHint: Optional: connect Infobip for automatic sending, delivery status and replies.
providerCostsHint: Additional provider costs are charged directly by the provider to your account.
infobipOAuthUnavailable: OAuth is not configured for this installation. You can connect your own Infobip account with an API key instead.
internalRequiresInfobip: Connect Infobip first to use this channel internally.
senderResourceHint: Enter the sender, number or channel resource configured in your provider account.
telegramInitiationHint: Telegram cannot be initiated through Infobip. The recipient must contact the configured Telegram channel first; replies can then be handled internally.
socialAddressesHint: Optional identifiers for Telegram, Instagram or Messenger.
recipientSelectionRequired: Select the recipient in the opened app.
infobipBaseUrlHint: Use the personal API Base URL shown in your Infobip account.
externalOpenedNotConfirmed: The app is opened for each recipient. Zahlmeister records this step, but cannot confirm that the message was actually sent.
bankImportHint: Import CAMT.053, MT940 or CSV. Exact payment references are assigned automatically; uncertain matches are shown for review.
detailedExportHint: Includes payment date, method, reference and reminders.
automaticReminderHint: With internal delivery, reminders run automatically in the background.
externalReminderHint: With external delivery, reminders remain manual.
resetLinkSent: If the account exists, a reset link has been sent.
invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired.
passwordResetSuccess: Password changed. You can sign in now.
passwordMinLength: The password must contain at least 8 characters.
emailVerificationHint: Verify your email address to secure your account.
exportMyDataHint: Download your Zahlmeister data as a ZIP file.
deleteAccountWarning: This permanently deletes your account and all associated data. This cannot be undone.
bankSyncHint: Optional bank connection for automatic payment matching.
pontoCostsHint: Ponto is an optional external service. Any usage costs are billed directly by Ponto.
automaticBankMatchingHint: Zahlmeister syncs bank data in the background. Only exact payment references are matched automatically; uncertain matches remain for review.
onlinePaymentsHint: Optional Apple Pay, Google Pay, card and other online payment methods.
mollieCostsHint: Mollie is an optional external payment service. Fees are billed directly through the user’s Mollie account. Zahlmeister never holds the funds.
onlineCheckoutHint: Available payment methods are shown by the payment provider.
checkoutFailed: The online payment could not be opened.
paymentMessageOptionsHint: Choose whether payment messages include the payment link, the QR code, or both.
paymentQrExternalHint: For external sending, the QR image is provided for saving or sharing.
authenticationFailed: Sign-in failed. Please check your details and try again.
portalBusinessPurposeValue: Services in automated data processing and information technology
portalContactSuccess: Thank you. Your message has been sent.
portalContactError: Your message could not be sent. Please try again later.
portalContactInvalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
portalContactPrivacyHint: Your details are used only to process your enquiry.
portalContactBody: Questions about Zahlmeister, setup or operation? Contact us directly.
portalFeaturesIntro: Everything you need to request, track and reconcile payments without spreadsheets and manual follow-up.
portalHowIntro: From contact list to confirmed payment in three clear steps.
portalImprintIntro: Information according to Austrian e-commerce and company law.
portalPrivacyDataBody: We process account, contact, participant, collection, payment and technical usage data only as required to provide, secure and operate Zahlmeister and to fulfil legal obligations. Payment data is processed only to the extent necessary for assignment and documentation.
portalPrivacyIntro: This overview explains how personal data is handled when using Zahlmeister.
portalPrivacyRightsBody: Depending on the applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or object to processing. You may also lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority. Contact us at Support@Solvate.at.
portalStepOneBody: Import a list or add people manually. Email or phone number is enough.
portalStepThreeBody: Mark payments manually, import bank statements or use optional bank sync. Uncertain matches stay for review.
portalStepTwoBody: Set amount, due date and message. Zahlmeister creates individual payment references and links.
portalTrustDirect: Money goes directly to your account
portalTrustFlexible: Bank transfer first, online payments optional
requestFailed: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
apiAccessHint: External systems can use a versioned API for explicitly granted functions.
apiTokenOnce: The API key is shown in full only once. Store it securely now.
apiDocsHint: The public API is versioned at /api/public/v1. OpenAPI is available at /api/docs in development environments.
apiSecurity: API keys are stored only as hashes and can be revoked at any time.

sessionExpired: Session expired. Please sign in again.
languageFallback: Untranslated text is shown in German.
